name: io.github.ChiR24/unreal-engine-mcp
description: EngineWire: drive the Unreal Editor (UE 5.0-5.8): levels, Blueprints, UI, materials, VFX and more.

environmentVariables.name: UE_PROJECT_PATH
environmentVariables.description: Your Unreal project folder or its .uproject file. The server reads the capability token from <project>/Saved/MCP/capability-token.

environmentVariables.name: MCP_AUTOMATION_CAPABILITY_TOKEN
environmentVariables.description: Capability token to present to the editor. Only needed when the server cannot read the project folder.

environmentVariables.name: UNREAL_MCP_URL
environmentVariables.description: The editor's native MCP endpoint (Project Settings > EngineWire > Native MCP Port).

environmentVariables.name: LOG_LEVEL
environmentVariables.description: Log level. Logs go to stderr.

author: ChiR24
